F3_TRUE

       |}

---


spectral_support3 F3_ID_X
     = 4%nat
     : nat

spectral_support3 F3_AND_XY
     = 2%nat
     : nat

spectral_support3 F3_XOR
     = 8%nat
     : nat


spectral_pattern3 F3_ID_X
     = [0x1.%xQ;
        0x1.%xQ;
        0x1.%xQ;
        0x1.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ]
     : list Q

spectral_pattern3 F3_AND_XY
     = [0x0.%xQ;

        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ]

spectral_pattern3 F3_XOR
     = [0x0.%xQ;
        (-0x0.)%xQ;
        (-0x0.)%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        (-0x0.)%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
        0x0.%xQ;
